scenes.title: Black Friday Laptop Purchase
scenes.description: An individual must decide whether and what computing device to purchase during Black Friday promotions. Trade-offs between performance, portability, longevity, and cost.

scenes.title: Black Friday Smartphone Purchase
scenes.description: A buyer compares flagship and mid-range phones during seasonal discounts. Decision factors include camera quality, battery, software support, and total value.

scenes.title: Black Friday Headphones Purchase
scenes.description: A buyer compares headphone options during seasonal discounts. The discussion balances sound quality, noise cancellation, comfort, portability, and cost.

scenes.title: Travel Planning Discussion — Asia
scenes.description: A group selects an Asia destination and trip direction in one session. It balances budget, vacation days, weather timing, and travel style.

scenes.title: Travel Planning Discussion — Europe
scenes.description: A group narrows Europe options with clear trade-offs across cost, seasonality, and route structure. It compares destination types and trip pacing.

scenes.title: Travel Planning Discussion — Oceania
scenes.description: A group plans an Oceania trip by weighing long-haul cost, reversed seasons, and destination style across Australia, New Zealand, and Pacific islands.

scenes.title: Wildfire Mitigation Policy
scenes.description: A group engages in collaborative policy discussion addressing wildfire mitigation and long-term community resilience. Evaluating multiple policy directions.

scenes.title: Urban Flood Preparedness Policy
scenes.description: A city-level team debates flood resilience strategies. It considers drainage investment, zoning constraints, emergency response readiness, and equity impacts.

scenes.title: Drought & Water Resource Policy
scenes.description: A policy team evaluates drought response strategies under limited funding. It compares conservation, supply expansion, allocation reform, and emergency capacity.
